posts.text: 🇺🇸 🇺🇦 ⚡️ US State Department approves a potential $621.9 million F-16 sustainment package for Ukraine, funded by Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway through JUMPSTART, with no US funds involved. The package covers aircraft sustainment devices, laboratory equipment, and transport support to help maintain Ukraine’s F-16 fleet and strengthen its air defense capabilities. @IntelSlava
США выступят в поддержку любого варианта украинского урегулирования, который приведет к завершению боевых действий, заявил Кушнер.

Кушнер призвал Зеленского уважительнее говорить с Трампом. "Во-первых, президент Трамп должен определить, отвечает ли предоставление гарантий безопасности (Украине — прим. ТАСС) американским интересам. Во-вторых, Зеленский, как можно предположить, должен уважительно и доброжелательно взаимодействовать с ним, чтобы узнать, готов ли президент Трамп на это пойти", — сказал Кушнер в подкасте главы медиаконцерна Axel Springer Матиаса Дёпфнера. ✔️ Подпишись на ТАСС в "Максе"

Йемен предупредил Саудовскую Аравию: эвакуируйте порты — Сегодня вооружённые силы Йемена заявили, что в случае реализации Саудовской Аравией угроз нанести удар по йеменскому порту Ходейда они нанесут удары по порту Джидда и всем саудовским портам на побережье Красного моря. — Официальный представитель вооружённых сил Йемена Яхья Сариа в своём заявлении призвал всех сотрудников и рабочих саудовских портов, а также жителей прилегающих районов немедленно покинуть эти территории. Судоходным компаниям также рекомендовано вывести свои суда из указанных портов. @parstodayrussian

🚨 🇪🇬 A tanker carrying petroleum products overturned and caught fire on Cairo's Ring Road in Giza's Warraq district, killing 30 people and injuring 15, according to preliminary figures from Egypt's Health Ministry. The ministry deployed 39 ambulances, raised emergency readiness at nearby hospitals, and sent two deputy ministers to the scene and referral hospitals. The Electricity Ministry said the fire damaged two 66-kilovolt circuits, which were temporarily disconnected. Follow: @BreakingGlobalHQ

🇬🇧 🇺🇦 The British public are once again being fed a diet of fear through increasingly sensational headlines. The Times headline, claiming that a Russian satellite network could allow Putin to fly drones over London, is a striking example of how hypothetical military capabilities can be presented in a way that fuels public anxiety. Ukrainian intelligence claims to have identified 49 Russian companies involved in these projects and intends to disrupt their operations through strikes and sabotage. Particular attention is reportedly being paid to the Plesetsk Cosmodrome. So far, sanctions have affected only 24 of the companies. Kiev is also seeking to prevent Russia from obtaining satellite radio-frequency allocations through the relevant UN body. Meanwhile, Ukraine is reportedly developing its own satellite network, Obria , consisting of more than 100 satellites. On 1 October, Ukrainian company Himera and Danish firm GomSpace launched the first experimental Obria Nano satellite aboard a SpaceX rocket. Deploying the full constellation is expected to take between two and five years and require hundreds of millions of euros. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

• 📝 Threat near Svatove 📝 Activity by Ukrainian formations in the sector of the "West" grouping of forces is growing not only near Lyman . An even bigger problem looms on the neighboring Borova direction . There, according to preliminary reports, the AFU is consolidating in Kruglyakivka , and there are also reports of UAV operators being deployed to this village. ➡️ Reports of AFU attempts to advance here first appeared in late October – early November and were quite expected. At that time, theories also emerged about AFU attacks related to craters from airstrikes in the depths of Russian Armed Forces-controlled territory. ➡️ Some channels even write about a large-scale offensive and AFU attempts to drive the Russian Armed Forces out of the Izyum District , but there is little concrete information from there so far. Note that our sources confirm some of the information, but there is no talk of a front collapse. 📌 The situation in this direction was and remains difficult, especially given the secondary importance of this direction even relative to neighboring areas of responsibility of the "West" grouping. Just recently, Ukrainian formations conducted a series of counterattacks near Lyman , and the Borova direction was one of the potential directions for continuation of AFU operations. ❗️ Another reason to "pay attention" to this direction is a series of sudden publications with movements of silhouettes with tricolors added in post-processing. Previously, similar fakes worked in favor of the AFU on the Lyman direction , when accumulation was occurring in formally "Russian Armed Forces-controlled" villages. Now, amid silence from Ukrainian resources and self-reassuring reports about successes that serve as information cover for the AFU offensive, there is a risk of a tactical crisis at Svatove .
